items.title: Results posted for a study of Benralizumab for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
items.summary: AstraZeneca ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 689 people. The registry lists its end date as 28 Jul 2025. The study team posted its results on ClinicalTrials.gov. Our search of PubMed and Europe PMC for this study’s number (NCT04053634) found no journal article. Searches can miss articles, so one may already exist. We don’t say here whether the treatment worked. The official study record has the full results.

items.title: A study of BLU-5937 for Cough was stopped early
items.summary: Bellus Health Inc. - a GSK company ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 1,019 people. The study team’s reason: “The study has been terminated due to the decision to cease further development of camlipixant in refractory chronic cough (RCC), based on the results of the Phase 3 program”. The registry lists its end date as 2 Sep 2026.
